title: Cheesy Broccoli Pasta Bake
subtitle: with Crunchy Crumbs
description: When broccoli cheese meets pasta bake, you know you're in for serious comfort food. Toss penne, broccoli and peas in a creamy sauce, then top with parmesan and breadcrumbs and bake until deliciously golden.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C (see Make it yours). Grease a 1L (4 cup) baking dish. Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil for the pasta and peas. Thinly slice the onion. Cut the broccoli stem into 1cm chunks. Cut the head into small florets. Coarsely grate the cheddar. Finely grate the parmesan.
Cook pasta and peas: Cook the pasta in the pan of boiling water for 8 mins. Add the peas and cook for a further 2 mins or until the pasta is al dente and the peas are tender. Drain.

Start filling: Meanwhile, melt 20g butter in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the onion, stirring, for 3-4 mins until softened. Add 1 tbs plain flour and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until golden. Add the broccoli, 60ml (¼ cup) milk, 1 tsp dijon mustard and 310ml (1¼ cups) water and stir to combine.

Simmer filling: Bring the broccoli mixture to the boil, then reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 mins or until the broccoli is tender. Remove the pan from the heat. Stir in the cheddar and pasta and peas, then season with salt and pepper.
Bake and serve up: Transfer the pasta mixture to the baking dish. Scatter over the breadcrumbs and parmesan. Bake for 10 mins or until golden. Divide the pasta bake among bowls and enjoy!

Make it yours: If you don't want to turn on the oven, simply serve the pasta mixture with the parmesan and breadcrumbs sprinkled on top. For extra-crispy crumbs, fry them in a medium frypan with a little oil until golden.
